card.name: The 2 in "every 12 hours"
card.fires_on: The digit 2 right after "every 1" in dosing intervals, which completes "every 12 hours" or "every 12 weeks". It also fires weakly on "every" in a repeating-interval phrase.

modes.label: Digit 2 completing 12
modes.description: The final digit of the number 12 after "every 1" in a dosing interval.
modes.example: subcutaneously every 1<<2>> hours in conjunction with oral aspirin therapy

modes.label: The word every
modes.description: The word "every" before a day or week count in an injection schedule.

card.writes: It suppresses schedule-related words such as scheduled, schedule, periodic and regular, so the text after the interval is less likely to repeat schedule wording.
card.plain: It fires when a dose is repeated at a set interval, mostly the "2" in "every 12 hours".
